top_signals.title: Adobe Analysts Have Never Been So Bearish as AI Fears Mount
top_signals.summary: Analyst sentiment toward Adobe Inc. has never been lower, amid growing conviction that the maker of software for creative professionals will struggle to compete in the artificial intelligence era.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Turkey’s Fast-Growing Corporate Bond Market Grapples With Funds Crisis Fallout
top_signals.summary: The crisis roiling Turkey’s investment industry may be spilling into its fast-growing corporate bond market, potentially crimping smaller companies’ access to financing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: BC Leans on US to Fund Deficit as Eby Rides Anti-American Mood
top_signals.summary: With British Columbia voters heading to the polls next week, the ruling party is raising anti-US sentiment and urging residents to avoid the country altogether. The boycott doesn’t seem to apply to the bond market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
